notes.title: Join the Spoorky's Weekly Challenge #5 tournament now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33749154/c2ea4e4e412673fefa4bc64eac2ed6cb5efc48c9.png[/img]

[h1]Hi, inhabitants of Spoorkland![/h1]
The Weekly Challenge tournament is running until Sunday 18:00 GMT. You can check your local time out in [url=https://spoorky.com]spoorky.com[/url] or in the Weekly Challenge section of the game.

Take a look at the best levels you selected this week, and don't forget to join the tournament to obtain juicy Hooves and game score:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PE0ulnJWpRs
When the Weekly Challenge ends, users get some Spoorky Hooves depending on the leaderboard position:
[list]
[*] [b]Bronze Hoof.[/b] Top 30.
[*] [b]Silver Hoof.[/b] Top 15.
[*] [b]Gold Hoof.[/b] Top 5.
[*] [b]Platinum Hoof.[/b] First position.
[/list]
You'll only get the most valued Hoof in each level, they are not accumulative in the same leaderboard.

[quote]Note that you'll need to complete the first world of Training mode to join the Weekly Challenge. If you did that, go to the Play menu and select the glowing button.[/quote]

Don't forget to use badges to increase your level score in the tournament to get Platinum Hooves. Let's fight, Spoorkies!

notes.title: Join the Spoorky Demo on Nov. 6!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33749154/b1770fecae1f2c2cf3d4e8f6ed7d5f2b30090d1d.png[/img]
[b]Prepare your hooves to discover unlimited challenges next Tuesday[/b] on Steam! The Spoorky demo includes direct access to the game community and online level play/edit, but some features are limited or locked. Take a look at the summary below:

[h1]Available features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Master the main mechanics with Training Mode ([i]Limited: 2 levels only[/i]).
[*] Play levels uploaded by other users ([i]lives limits[/i])
[*] Create your own levels ([i]Level editor is enabled, but uploading disabled for demo users[/i])
[/list]

[h1]Full game only[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Unlimited play.[/b] Lives don't exist in the full game, play as many times as you wish. Game tickets are also enabled to find interesting levels.
[*] [b]Tournaments[/b]. The weekly challenge will start at 12:00 pm, on Thursday, 15th of November (UTC) for full game users. You'll need to complete the first Training Mode world to unlock the access.
[*] [b]Upload your own levels.[/b] Share your creations with the Spoorky community and fight for reigning in your levels' leaderboard against other users.
[*] [b]Training mode.[/b] Complete this challenges to master the game mechanics and unlock new worlds, items and other features.
[*] [b]Full community access.[/b] Follow other users, share and rate levels, search levels/users...
[*] [b]Achievements.[/b] Compete against other players to get all the Steam achievements.
[*] Much more!
[/list]

We'll wait for your on [b]November 6[/b] to join the Spoorky Community with the free Spoorky Demo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33749154/561d1ee9a6bbcf140eb71b2d93c1e74047b85f70.gif[/img]

[h1]Account verify[/h1]
This feature is focused on streamers, special accounts like press media who want to get the best presence on the Spoorky community and creates Spoorky content, and other influencers: feel free to reach us out to verify your game account. This will display a special badge on your game profile. (contact us via support@gugames-dev.com ).

There are also planned functionalities for special verified accounts that we cannot guarantee to include yet, so we will speak about them later.
